backend_api.section_order_persistence: PASS - Reorder changes persist to MongoDB

frontend_ui.reorder_arrows: PASS - 9 up arrows and 9 down arrows found, clicking reorders sections

critical_code_review_comments: Layout system implementation is clean and follows React best practices
EditorContext properly manages layout state with layoutPending for unsaved changes
LayoutSection component correctly handles visibility and padding classes
HomePage dynamically renders sections based on orderedSections from layout settings
Backend properly validates admin auth before allowing layout saves
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS Layout System Phase 1 complete. All 9 homepage sections can be: reordered (up/down arrows), hidden/shown (visibility toggle), configured with padding (none/small/medium/large/xl) and content width (narrow/normal/wide). Image defaults (fit mode, aspect ratio) also configurable. Layout tab only appears on homepage. Settings persist in MongoDB layout_settings collection. Public visitors see hidden sections removed from DOM; editors see them dimmed with 'Ausgeblendet' label.
features_verified: Backend: GET /api/editor/layout?page=home returns layout settings (public, no auth needed)
Backend: POST /api/admin/layout saves layout settings (requires admin token)
Admin login works at /admin with password: visuworks2026
After login and activating editor, navigating to homepage shows editor sidebar with two tabs: INHALT and LAYOUT
Layout tab shows all 9 sections: Keyword Hero, Trust Bar, Leistungen, Visual Showcase, Projekte, Prozess, Kundenstimmen, FAQ, CTA
Each section has: visibility toggle (eye icon), up/down reorder arrows, expand chevron
Expanding a section shows: Abstand oben (padding top), Abstand unten (padding bottom), Inhaltsbreite (content width) dropdowns
Image defaults section at bottom shows: Standard Fit-Modus and Standard Seitenverhältnis dropdowns
Layout speichern button saves layout to backend (POST /api/admin/layout)
Visibility toggle: hiding a section shows it as dimmed (opacity-30) with 'Ausgeblendet' label in editor mode, and completely hidden for public visitors
Section reordering: clicking up/down arrows changes section order on the homepage
Homepage renders all 9 sections dynamically based on layout order from settings
Padding changes: changing padding values persists correctly
Content width: changing width values persists correctly
Image defaults: fit mode and aspect ratio settings persist correctly
